summary: Carddamda V1 is implemented as a single-screen React app with structured purchase rows, grouped search result states, server-side Naver Shopping integration, normalized provider contracts, and TCGShop direct-search auxiliary actions. Tests, build, API health, real Naver API access, and browser rendering were verified.
evidence: npm test: 4 files passed, 6 tests passed
npm run build: TypeScript and Vite build passed
POST /api/search preserves grouped failure state and TCGShop direct action without credentials
One-off official Naver Shopping API call with test credentials returned HTTP 200
